style: Pragmatic, counter-attacking side that defends in a compact mid-block and springs forward through a creative attacking core. Comfortable ceding possession to stronger opponents and exploiting transitions, with set pieces a notable weapon.
recent_form: Entered their first-ever World Cup as Group K underdogs alongside Portugal, Colombia and DR Congo after a landmark Asian qualifying campaign. Form modest against elite opposition but disciplined defensively.

key_players.name: Eldor Shomurodov
key_players.note: All-time top scorer (44 goals in 92 caps). Joint-top scorer in the Turkish league in 2025-26 on loan at Istanbul Basaksehir; Serie A pedigree with Roma, Genoa and Cagliari.

key_players.name: Abdukodir Khusanov
key_players.note: Manchester City centre-back, first Uzbek in the Premier League after a ~40m euro move from Lens. Pace and top-level experience anchor the backline.

key_players.name: Abbosbek Fayzullaev
key_players.note: 22-year-old at Istanbul Basaksehir; dynamic, creative hub who links play and supplies Shomurodov on the break.

historical_news: Making their first-ever FIFA World Cup appearance, one of the headline newcomers of the expanded 2026 tournament.
Drawn in Group K with Portugal, Colombia and DR Congo, cast as clear underdogs.
Lost an early-tournament meeting with Colombia, a result that helped lift Colombia to 11th in the FIFA ranking.

media_sentiment.label: positive
media_sentiment.summary: Coverage celebrates a historic debut and Uzbekistan's golden generation led by Khusanov and Shomurodov, while tempering expectations against a tough group.
